 The soundtrack melds Chinese folk music, pop, rock and contains elements of Buddhism, a mysterious multi-faceted culture.

notes.title: Viewer mode added
notes.content:
Hello everyone, in order to improve the viewing experience of the viewers watching the live stream, we have specially added the viewer mode to the streamers. When this mode is enabled, the brightness of the game output on the screen will be greatly improved. The brightness of the game output in the Head Mounted Display is unchanged.
The method of opening is as follows:
1.	Right click on the PaperDolls in the steam library，Click Properties. As shown below:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663836/0208cb01017b4f3cd06fb42e7490b7d8e43b7734.jpg
2.	Click on the BETAS tab, Select Viewer Mode from the drop down menu. As shown below:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663836/bfb057c6e5336d3e0e4a8ff14b425f2855a3159c.jpg
